summary: Phase 3 retest (iter16). Verified all 3 iteration_15 blocker fixes: (1) Get Flowers desktop submit CTA (get-flowers-review-btn-desktop) is visible/clickable at 1440x900; (2) public homepage primary buttons — Get started / Join FloraSetu / Get flowers / Find flowers / Plan an event / Join as a supplier / Partner with FloraSetu — all show color rgb(255,255,255) on rgb(24,61,51); (3) Draft persistence code fix is in place (see caveat). End-to-end offer/order/evidence chain UI now works: submitted QUICK requirement → RFQ landed in Dev Supplier Co inbox (/api/demand/rfqs/inbox), quote created via API → /buyer/offers shows '1 offer received' → Compare offers page shows Dev Supplier Co, 100 (100%), Matches, ₹420, ₹42,000, Freight pending, TBC delivery, valid 23/9/2026, landed cost expandable (≈₹420/unit), sort dropdown, NO Best/Recommended labels → Select offer opens select-offer-dialog with consequence summary and Quantity field → Confirm supplier shows success banner. No 'FloraSetu QC' / 'QC Approved' strings anywhere. Regressions: supplier requests page shows RFQ card, /partner/logistics loads, /buyer/events empty state no RFQ terminology, 390px bottom nav testids all work.

rca_of_the_issue: For the 'Invalid Date' on timeline: BuyerOrderPage passes an unguarded date string into new Date(). When the audit event for AWARD_CONFIRMED has no occurred_at (or a non-ISO shape), Date(undefined).toLocaleString() renders 'Invalid Date'. Fix: either backend must emit an ISO occurred_at for the award-confirmation event, or the UI must guard formatting with a null check. Repro: navigate to /buyer/orders/572c028d-5706-45f5-802c-f72eea2096fd (any order created via UI Confirm supplier).
